raw_sections.summary:
PROFILE SUMMARY
Associate Manager with 7+ years of experience in Fund Accounting, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Reconciliation, Trade Capture, and Fund Administration. Proven expertise in NAV review, investor reporting, fund migrations, portfolio reconciliations, and oversight operations across global investment structures. Experienced in managing cross-functional teams, client relationships, audit support, and process automation. Strong knowledge of capital markets and financial instruments, including Equities, Fixed Income Securities, Bonds, Money Market Instruments, Derivatives, and Crypto Funds.
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE Formidium India Pvt. Ltd. (Associate Manager – Private Equity)
May 2024 – Aug 2025
Roles and Responsibilities
Managed end-to-end fund onboarding and project setup, including processing input feeds, performing reconciliations, executing fund conversions during production parallel runs, and successfully launching funds with complete reconciliation and direct client reporting.
Communicated process updates across the team, incorporated amendments into Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), prepared audit control points, and maintained process-related documentation.
Prepared and reviewed monthly, quarterly, and semi-annual NAV packages, validated capital call notices, and reconciled them against broker reports.
Managed a team of Associates and Senior Associates responsible for end-to-end Private Equity Fund Accounting across EMEA and US regions, overseeing investor-level reporting and portfolio reconciliations between custodians and investment managers.
Designed and delivered process-specific training for new hires and existing team members, reviewed fund activities, and managed daily work allocation, leave planning, and workload balancing.
Built and maintained strong client relationships by independently managing daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly deliverables.
Collaborated with onshore teams, clients, and auditors to address business requirements and provide timely support during financial audits, ensuring adherence to agreed deadlines.
Supported multiple fund structures, including Hedge Funds, Mutual Funds, Master-Feeder Funds, Multi-Manager Funds, and ACS Funds, while driving process improvements and maintaining a strong control environment.
Led global fund migrations and system conversions, ensuring accurate historical data transfer and successful onboarding onto the eFront platform.
Performed determination date processes for compliance teams by reconciling cash balances against broker records at specified reporting dates.
• Possess extensive experience in Private Equity Fund Accounting, including investor onboarding,
NAV review, financial statement review, partners' capital accounting, carried interest
calculations, and waterfall modeling.
Performed pre-upload validation and bulk upload of trade, cash, position, pricing, and security master data during fund onboarding, migrations, and production parallel runs, ensuring data completeness and accuracy.
Executed trade enrichment by validating trade attributes, SSI, counterparty details, broker information, settlement instructions, and security reference data to enable accurate downstream trade processing and settlements.
Managed bulk data uploads for new fund launches and conversions by validating input feeds, reconciling uploaded records with source files, and resolving data discrepancies before production deployment.
Conducted pre-processing validation of portfolio transactions, corporate actions, cash movements, and valuation data to minimize processing exceptions, improve STP rates, and support timely NAV calculations.
Collaborated with Fund Accounting, Operations, and Technology teams to validate, enrich, reconcile, and upload trade and portfolio data, ensuring seamless fund launches, accurate reconciliations, and successful client deliveries.
Bank of New York Mellon (Senior Associate –fund Accounting)
Mar. 2020 - April2024
Roles and Responsibilities
Managed end-to-end hedge fund accounting operations, including journal entries, accruals, cash reconciliations, management fee calculations, and investor-level reporting.
Oversaw the complete capital activity lifecycle, including capital calls, distributions, management fee allocations, withholding tax calculations, and preparation of investor notices and reports.
Reviewed and approved NAV calculations, ensuring accuracy in financial reporting, payment processing, and client deliverables.
Performed daily, weekly, and monthly NAV calculations using Geneva and conducted share, cash, and position reconciliations with brokers and custodians.
Reviewed capital call and distribution calculations, prepared investor notices, and ensured timely release to investors.
Collaborated closely with onshore teams, clients, and auditors to meet audit deadlines and support financial statement preparation and approval processes.
Recorded and reviewed expenses, revenues and account-related transactions, calculated Daily and Monthly NAV and prepared monthly NAV packages. Recorded and reviewed fund expenses, revenues, and account-related transactions; calculated daily and monthly NAVs; and prepared comprehensive monthly NAV packages.
Trained new joiners, allocated team workloads, managed ad-hoc requests, and prepared dashboards for management reporting.
Working of fund launching, migrate and team automation projects.
State Street Syntel Service Trade Analyst (Trade capture management)
Aug. 2018 –Feb.2020
Roles and Responsibilities
Review client securities instructions, cancellations, and amendments for funds in an accurately and timely manner within the NAV deadlines.
• Working as a member of the trade processing team that includes trade capture, Matching and
settlement of securities, Trade, FX, Future, Options and Money market.
• Process Global Security transactions on the Global trade processing platforms within given
deadlines.

Interact with both internal and external stake holders to resolve trade related issues.
Reconciling of transactions blotter and swift to confirm the accounting has processed in a timely
and accurate manner thus ensuring we do not miss NAV deadlines.
Ensure all trades are matched 100% with swifts, without any discrepancy also clear types break (security, missing trade information, pricing) and centralized trade for NAV calculations.
Ensure client positions are correct and all transactions are processed.
Exceptions out of system tolerance are cleared by taking backups from Bloomberg terminal and ICE.
Handling audit requirements and ad hoc client requirements in fund accounting
Query resolution in accordance with time frames set out in client SLAs.
• Updating client SOP’s and fund recording in Webex, for new joiners’ purpose.
• Escalating exceptions to client for early resolution.
Reviewing the daily work in terms of risk, identify failures, missing controls, and discuss/propose solutions to solve them.
PROFESSIONAL SKILLSET • Fund Launching • Merger project • Working on team automation • Team management • Reconciliation, Cash & Position, Fund Accounting,
TECHNICAL SKILLSET
MS Office (outlook, Excel, word and power point) • Xceptor, Bloomberg, ICE, Invest One, Eagle, Trace, GRX, Seamless • Geneva, Swifts, MCH, Test key, TLM
ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS
Modern Institute of business management, Pune University MBA (Finance) 2018
M. D. Palesha College of Commerce, North Maharashtra University B.com (commerce) 2016
REWARD AND PROJECTS • Recipient of two time ‘Syntel Champ Award’ in Jan. 2019 and May 2019
Recipient of ‘SPOT award’ for processing high volume consistently.
Appraised by superiors for being a quick learner of the process and performing well to complete the allocated work before time.
Received the WOW an internal award in BNY Mellon for delivering the work Excellence and being Client focus.
Commended by clients and leadership for managing multiple fund migrations and delivering accurate cash reconciliations under tight timelines.
Recognized for new fund and awarded Kudos for consistent high performance and support.
Appreciated for leading reconciliation break-resolution(application automation), reducing breaks and manual intervention.
DECLARATION: I here-by declare that, the above information furnished by me is true, correct and complete, to the
best of my knowledge and belief.

(Sneha Dattatray Aakhade)
